Real good guy. Took this class over the summer and got an 'A.' Some people struggled in this class and I believe it really determines if accounting and finance is for you. comment: He is the worst professor I have had at Fisher by far. His exams are nearly impossible to pass and its a grading system that only he understands. great professor. He was extremely willing to help his students&was willing to work with students as long as you show youre trying. This class was mostly a lot of A&P lab quizzes, and 2 lab practicals. If you study, review the materials she gives, and listen to the lectures in the lab, you will do just fine. I had Dr. Anderson for lab last semester and she was amazing! She was super kind and she really knew her stuff! The content is hard to follow sometimes no matter who you have, but she made it much easier to understand.

Dr. Anderson was my favorite professor this year. Forbes is a solid teacher. He likes to talk and repeat things over and over, so be prepared. Otherwise he is very knowledgeable, easy to talk to, and his class is interesting. comment: Fee is an adjunct professor, he is really nice but I feel like this class is a waste of money, he doesn't add any interesting or useful content to the lesson because he just reads out of the text book, I don't even read the text book anymore bc he does it for us in class. This is a fantastic professor. He is hilarious and very passionate about what he is teaching. You will definitely leave his class knowing how to write a research paper.

Dr. O'Neil is an amazing teacher, he is very helpful in writing. Scott was a great teacher and for sure what you would want in a English professor.

Doc Mapes is The G.O.A.T.!!!!!

Dr. Maples is definitely the best teacher I have had since I entered college. She always found a way to include us in the lecture, which was one of the reasons I loved going to her class!
We all love her! Shes funny, caring, passionate and makes you always do your best.

Capstone is hard, but Dr. Maples supports you the whole way and has such high expectations for you. She gives you a lot of feedback to revise your paper and make it better. Be prepared to write and rewrite but then you are surprised at what you have written because its really good. Could not imagine taking this course with anyone else.

Best class I took at Fisher. Learned a lot about technology, and they were things I could ACTUALLY use in the classroom. She makes you work for it, but she cares so much about you being the best teacher you can be it doesn't seem that bad.

She changed my life. Changed me. Made me think about issues in ways I hadnt before. I learned a lot about myself.

Good books--so good they were the first books I ever read from start to finish. She's funny, demanding, challenges you, but you know she cares about you. Goes above and beyond for you. I wish I had more classes with her.
Read a lot of good books in her class. Demanding, but caring. I learned a lot.

Could not have done capstone without her

I want to be a teacher like her--passionate, funny, caring, and pushes our thinking. She cares about us and challenges us. I look forward to her class every time. I never know what to expect and I always learn a lot.

Amazing! She knows her stuff and is really passionate about teaching. Pushes us to think. Cares about us. I'm a better person for having her as a teacher. I hope I can influence my students like she has me.
